cards.name: The Burden of Power
cards.text:
The holder of the Throne chooses, in order, any number of the following:
a) resolve the event New Information.
b) resolve the event Shifting Ambitions.
c) resolve the event Thwarted Plans.

cards.name: Bands of Outlaws
cards.text:
Players secretly bid against the round target (ties in Raven order):
Won, Highest Bid: gains 3 Gold Coins.
Lost - Lowest Bid: loses 1 Gold Coin and 2 positions on the Supply track.
Lost - Others: lose 1 Gold Coin and 1 position on the Supply track.

bid.lowest: loses 1 Gold Coin and 2 positions on the Supply track.
bid.others: lose 1 Gold Coin and 1 position on the Supply track.

cards.name: Bountiful Harvest
cards.text: All players move forward 1 step on the Supply track and gain 1 Gold Coin.

cards.name: Flawless Strategy
cards.text:
Players secretly bid against the round target (ties in Sword order):
Won, Highest Bid: may return any House Card to their hand.
Lost - Lowest Bid: discards all House Cards with the highest strength.
Lost - Others: discard one House Card at random.

bid.won: may return any House Card to their hand.
bid.lowest: discards all House Cards with the highest strength.
bid.others: discard one House Card at random.

cards.name: Knights of the Seven Kingdoms
cards.text:
Players secretly bid against the round target (ties in Throne order):
Won, Highest Bid: may replace up to two Footmen with Knights.
Lost - Lowest Bid: replaces all Knights with Footmen.
Lost - Others: replace two Knights with Footmen.

bid.won: may replace up to two Footmen with Knights.

cards.name: Militant Faith
cards.text: For each Stronghold, its controller destroys one unit in that area. If there are none, they remove from the game one of the House Cards in their hand with the highest strength.

cards.name: Peasant Uprising
cards.text: Each player may discard 1 Power Token for every 2 Supply levels they have. If they cannot or do not want, reduce their Supply level by 1 for every Power Token not spent.

cards.name: Royal Tournament
cards.text: All players simultaneously discard one of their House Cards. Add up strength and sword icons for each of them. The player with the highest total gains 5 Power Tokens, the player with the second highest total gains 3 Power Tokens (ties in Sword order).

cards.name: Storm at Sea
cards.text: Every player destroys 2 of their Ship units in Open Sea areas. If they have none, they destroy 1 of their Ship units in normal Sea areas. Ships in Ports are not affected.

cards.name: Treachery and Deceit
cards.text:
Players secretly bid against the round target (ties in Raven order):
Won, Highest Bid: moves to the top of any Influence track.
Lost - Lowest Bid: loses 2 positions on their highest influence track.
Lost - Others: discard 2 Power Tokens.

bid.won: moves to the top of any Influence track.
bid.lowest: loses 2 positions on their highest influence track.

cards.name: War Preparations
cards.text:
Players secretly bid against the round target (ties in Sword order):
Won, Highest Bid: may muster at a Castle or Stronghold.
Lost - Lowest Bid: destroys 2 of their units, if possible at a Castle.
Lost - Others: destroy 1 of their units, if possible at a Castle.

bid.won: may muster at a Castle or Stronghold.
bid.lowest: destroys 2 of their units, if possible at a Castle.
bid.others: destroy 1 of their units, if possible at a Castle.

cards.name: Wavering Loyalties
cards.text:
Players secretly bid against the round target (ties in Throne order):
Won, Highest Bid: puts Power Tokens from reserve on 3 controlled areas.
Lost - Lowest Bid: discards Power Tokens from all controlled areas.
Lost - Others: discard Power Tokens from 2 controlled areas.
